newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends up on refiners' buying.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends up on refiners' buying.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices rose in late trading to end up on refiners' buying. There was support seen around 1,242 and 1,243 ringgit (March Futures), with underlying good fundamentals underpinning sentiment. March futures support is seen at 1,230 and resistance at the 1,250 ringgit level.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Trading continued slow with interest focusing on nearby CPOs due to year-end factors.
